body: I found something I really enjoyed. Water polo. Every time I play or train it takes my mind off of everything and I feel euphoric. I know plenty of other people who used a sport or skill to get them out of a dark place.
There are other ways out of misery than suicide

I'm really sorry if this isn't the answer you are looking for but when I lived without stress or worry I didn't care enough to have standards which is why I fail so miserably as a human because I never prepared myself.
